svg.aria-label: User flow for giving access in four steps. Entry from the permissions list, a person or team page, or a data plane. 01 Who: TIBCO SSO, LDAP, SAML IdP or an existing team. 02 Where: whole organization, which skips to review with Owner, or specific places across DataPlane Management, Kubernetes capabilities and on prem products. 03 Role: only roles that fit the places. 04 Review, then assign, with an invitation, active access or a team update, and an audit record.
